bias.en: Neutral to bullish · sitting on the 100-day
bias.zh: 中性偏多 · 站在 100 日均线上

read.en: Alphabet edged up 0.3% on Oct 12 to $352.72 and sits just above its 100-day average ($352.5), which is still drifting lower. It is above its 5, 10 and 30-day averages ($343–350) and the 200-day ($340). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 5 with a slowly growing histogram, Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 8 ($336), and RSI is 57.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月12日小涨 0.3%，收于 $352.72，略高于仍在下行的 100 日均线（$352.5）。股价位于 5 日、10 日和 30 日均线（$343–350）及 200 日均线（$340）上方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线上方，柱体缓慢放大，抛物线 SAR 于 10月8日转多（$336），RSI 为 57。

read.en: Rallies stalled at $356–357 on Oct 8 and Oct 12. A close above that would open $364 (Sep 22 high, top of the three-week range), then $378. Support is $343–346 (10 and 30-day averages), then $336 (SAR and Oct 1 low) and $328 (Sep 10 low).
read.zh: 10月8日和 10月12日反弹均在 $356–357 受阻。若收盘站上该区域，可看 $364（9月22日高点，三周区间上沿），再看 $378。支撑为 $343–346（10 日和 30 日均线），其次 $336（SAR 及 10月1日低点）和 $328（9月10日低点）。

r.en: Sep 22 high, top of the 3-week range
